messages:
leo.procure: CostMetrics sent proposal for usage analytics + cost attribution. link: https://costmetrics.example.com/redwood-prop
maria.fp: can you paste headline pricing here? blocked from link on corp network.
vendor-costmetrics: hi all — short summary: PAYG: $0.25 / 1k embeddings ingested; $0.005 / 1k eval events; analytics API calls included up to 250k/mo then $0.04 / 1k. 12mo = 10% off, 24mo = 18% off + 1 month free.
finance-oliver: sample invoice for 30M embeddings + 5M eval events (monthly) please. also are embedding units rounded to 1k?
vendor-costmetrics: sample (rounded):
Line: embeddings.ingest | Qty: 30,000 (1k units) | Rate: $0.25 | Amount: $7,500
Line: events.eval | Qty: 5,000 (1k units) | Rate: $0.005 | Amount: $25
Analytics: 0 (within 250k included)
Total: $7,525
eng-maya: engineering Q: what are ingest latency percentiles at 1M events/day? retention for raw payloads and costs to increase retention to 365d?
vendor-costmetrics: P50/P95/P99 ingest latencies on standard cluster: 25ms / 140ms / 400ms at 1M/day. Dedicated cluster: 12ms / 60ms / 220ms. Default retention: 180 days. 365-day retention available for +20% on storage portion.
maria.fp: what are commit rules and overage billing? banking of unused credits? any early termination fees?
vendor-costmetrics: commits are annualized monthly minimums. Overages billed at PAYG above commit. Unused committed credits can roll forward up to 2 months for 12mo, 4 months for 24mo. Early termination: prorated refund of prepaid minus onboarding fee (capped), pilot periods exempt.
procurement-bot: Note: contracts > $75k/yr require Procurement + Legal + Security review. Attach SOW and SOC2 report.
leo.procure: propose 1-month PAYG pilot with $3k trial credit, then consider 12mo commit if TCO looks good. vendor: can you provide a PO-ready quote with pilot option and cancellation terms?
vendor-costmetrics: we can do a $3k trial credit, pilot has no termination penalty. Will produce PO-ready quote and SOW with engineering appendix by EOD. Who should we send billing contact for the PO?
maria.fp: send to billing@redwood-inference.com and cc me. I'll open procurement ticket and loop in Legal after quote.
finance-oliver: also confirm payment terms (Net30?), invoice cadence, and whether tax/VAT included.
vendor-costmetrics: Net30 monthly in arrears by default, prepaid amortization available for committed deals. Quotes exclude VAT; taxes shown on invoice.
leo.procure: thanks. next step: vendor to upload PO-ready docs; procurement will create PR-2026-452 and flag Legal if >$75k.
